issue.author: diagnostician

I will also own the CODEOWNERS split review and coordinate runs/evaluation through issues.
issue.title: Diagnostician commitment: run, compare, and record worker evidence

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Improve the worker of the position paper-repo of the research world rw_07ce7d5d6f6a, given to you to read (it is finished; its checkpoints include its final one). Its task was a one-paragraph report on how fast the CO2 at Mauna Loa rose over the last ten years, from NOAA's annual means downloaded during the work. The incumbent worker of every position there is Codex with gpt-6.1-sol at low reasoning effort.

Candidates may use only Codex with gpt-6.1-sol, the agent and model the target world runs; what may change is its native settings, such as its effort or its environment. Take the tasks from the target world; no judging is given, so propose it.

Keep it small: one candidate, and every world you run with at most 8 turns and 900 model seconds. Put the kept worker back by continuing rw_07ce7d5d6f6a from its newest checkpoint with it and running that round. An evaluation that keeps the incumbent is a complete result too: then the version released is the kept worker and the round that put it back. Nothing is published outside this world.
issue.title: Improvement objective

issue.author: task-setter
issue.body:
Task-setter release tasks-v1 is published from commit 2e4f487: http://172.17.0.1:33781/world/task-setter/releases/tag/tasks-v1

It contains Task P1 starting at rw_07ce7d5d6f6a checkpoint final-ef3a129, with a fixed 0–5 rubric for source evidence, endpoints, rate arithmetic, one-paragraph form, and publication handoff. Use this same judging for incumbent/candidate diagnostic comparisons and cite the release/task in records.
issue.title: Diagnostic tasks v1 available for evaluation

comments.author: trial-user
comments.body: Held-out tasks H1/H2 are in private commit 4dc8b44 at tasks/heldout_tasks.md; please read the file directly. Proposed rubric for each result: factual correctness against NOAA annual-mean data; reproducible arithmetic and interval convention; source/link traceability; required one-paragraph format; clarity and absence of invented precision/sources. H2 additionally requires endpoint subtraction and division by elapsed years stated in prose. I will run incumbent and one candidate from identical final-ef3a129f starts once you provide worker settings, then deliver opaque labels and result files; mapping stays private until you confirm every result is judged.

comments.author: trial-user
comments.body: Judge rubric acknowledged from your reply on issue #2. Tasks and criteria are fixed in commit 4dc8b44. I am ready to run H1/H2 from identical final-ef3a129f starts as soon as candidate worker settings are supplied; no runs have started yet.
